principles: Temporal baselines use only observations with match_date strictly earlier than the current match.
Matches sharing the same match_date cannot inform one another.
Missing base values remain missing; NULL is never converted to zero.
No arbitrary recent-match windows, ratings, weights, percentiles or expert thresholds are introduced in FEATURE-02.

operators.name: prior_mean
operators.description: Mean of all prior non-null observations.

operators.name: prior_std
operators.description: Population standard deviation of prior non-null observations; NULL when fewer than two exist.

operators.name: delta_prev
operators.description: Current value minus latest prior non-null observation; NULL if either side is missing.

operators.name: delta_prior_mean
operators.description: Current value minus prior mean; NULL if either side is missing.

operators.name: prior_slope
operators.description: OLS slope over the ordered prior non-null observations; NULL when fewer than two exist.
